summary.business_type: SaaS — free AI YouTube SEO tool (SoftwareApplication) with programmatic SEO glossary (EN/ES/PT), blog, and interactive tools
top_findings: 324-URL 'double-vs' glossary family ~73% broken (est. ~240 404s): /{term}-vs-vidiq-vs-tubebuddy and /{term}-vs-tubebuddy-vs-* URLs 404 in sitemap; also /glossary/vidiq-vs-tubebuddy EN+ES 404 (PT works)

5 remaining identical blog/tools slug pairs cannibalize (both indexable): youtube-for-tutorials-2026, youtube-intro-hook-first-3-seconds, youtube-monetization-tips-2026, youtube-seo-for-business-channels-2026, youtube-seo-for-gaming-channels-2026
Canonical loop on /tools: canonical points to /tools.html which 308-redirects back to /tools
Missing canonicals on /about, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /contact; duplicate canonical on some blog posts (e.g. /blog/youtube-tags-2026)
llms.txt stale/shallow: 17/50 blog posts, zero glossary entries (18k pages), llms-full.txt embeds a 'Page not found' section for /blog/generic-hero
quick_wins: Regenerate sitemap without the 324 double-vs URLs + fix /glossary/vidiq-vs-tubebuddy EN/ES (removes ~240 404s in one deploy)
301 the 5 residual /tools/* twins to /blog/* (or noindex the thin tool variants)
Regenerate llms.txt/llms-full.txt: all 50 blog posts + top glossary terms, strip broken entries

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Sitemap 18,090 URLs with lastmod on 99.7% (was 49 URLs); noindex core pages removed
Prior ~29% sitemap 404 rate reduced to ~1.3% (one generator family remains)
Strong security headers: strict CSP with AdSense+jsdelivr whitelisted, HSTS preload, nosniff, frame-options, security.txt
robots.txt allows all major AI crawlers; blocks only dev paths
Removed blog post returns correct 410 Gone

findings.title: 324 'double-vs' glossary URLs ~73% broken (~240 est. 404s)
findings.description: Pattern /{term}-vs-{tool}-vs-{tool} (tool=vidiq,tubebuddy). Sample 30 → 22 404. Plus /glossary/vidiq-vs-tubebuddy EN and ES 404 while PT renders.
findings.recommendation: Exclude slugs with 2+ -vs- segments from the glossary generator and sitemap; fix the vidiq-vs-tubebuddy EN/ES render path.

findings.title: /tools canonical points to redirecting tools.html
findings.description: canonical href=.../tools.html, which 308-redirects to /tools (canonical-to-redirect loop).

findings.title: Missing canonicals on 4 core pages
findings.description: /about, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /contact have no canonical tag.

findings.title: Duplicate canonical tags on some blog posts
findings.description: /blog/youtube-tags-2026 emits 2 identical canonical links.
findings.recommendation: Ensure blog template emits exactly one canonical.

findings.title: /blog/generic-hero orphan returns 200
findings.description: Stub page returns 200 and leaks into llms-full.txt as 'Page not found'.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog JSON-LD fixed — Article+FAQPage valid on 10/10 sampled posts (was ~50% unparseable)
/about indexable again; 50 blog posts all live with H1s, metas, internal links

findings.title: E-E-A-T still thin
findings.description: Anonymous authorship, Gmail contact, no author pages, no Person schema. Money-adjacent niche.
findings.recommendation: Add named author + author pages + Person schema; improve About page.

findings.title: AI-template blog titles persist
findings.description: 'Learn how to X 2026' pattern across many posts.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite titles for click-value and differentiation.

findings.title: Boilerplate tool descriptions
findings.description: ~95 tool pages + llms.txt use identical filler text.

findings.title: Blog SERP titles truncated
findings.description: 73-76 char titles with visible '…' truncation.

Single H1 on blog posts; correct hreflang en/es/pt/x-default on glossary
Homepage canonical correct; OG tags complete with valid 197KB og-image.png

findings.title: /tools canonical loop
findings.description: Canonical → tools.html → 308 → /tools.

findings.title: Missing canonicals on core pages

findings.title: Title lengths over guidance

findings.title: No VideoObject schema
